title: Structured (Extended)
description: Multi-part questions. Write your answer, then tick the points you earned. AI marking comes later.
instructions: Every question in this quiz is of one type: Structured (Extended).
Use it to test how this question type looks and is marked.

questions.question: A compiler and an interpreter both translate high-level code.

parts.label: a
parts.question: State **two** differences between a compiler and an interpreter.
markScheme: Compiler translates the whole program before it runs; interpreter translates line by line as it runs
Compiler produces a separate executable file; interpreter does not

parts.label: b
parts.question: Give **one** advantage of using a compiler.
markScheme: The program can run without the translator being installed

parts.label: c
parts.question: Give **one** advantage of using an interpreter during development.
markScheme: Part of the program can be tested without compiling it all
Errors are reported immediately, which helps debugging

questions.question: A ball is thrown vertically upwards at 12 m/s. Take g = 9.8 m/s² and ignore air resistance.

parts.label: a
parts.question: State the acceleration of the ball at its highest point.

parts.label: b
parts.question: Calculate the time taken to reach the highest point.
markScheme: Uses v = u + at with v = 0, giving 0 = 12 − 9.8t

questions.explanation: Use the equations of motion with a = −9.8 m/s².
